corpus.scope: Separate denominators: the pending semantic failure is not a successful extraction and the ISO reference is not an executable test.

rtl_unicode.scope: Selected source and SDK glyph ownership profile; not exhaustive Unicode, reading-order, natural-revision or production qualification.

browser.scope: Local Chrome only; exact selected native/WASM assertions, not exhaustive semantic accuracy or other-browser qualification.

semantic_gold.scope: Full selected page text after NFC and whitespace collapse; character order, marks and joiners retained. Guarded failures are failures, not correct extractions.

remaining_gaps: The newly collected Arabic page still has incorrect extracted Unicode: 0/1 full-page semantic gold; its equivalent rewrite is correctly guarded.
Historical source omissions, 75 Unicode-unavailable pages, unobserved text objects and reading-order review remain; a reduced mismatch count is not recovered source text.
Independent PDF.js discrepancies (19 documents and one resource limit), full natural-revision precision/recall, Windows/other browsers and deployment performance remain unqualified.
